title: 第6章 双职业
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
大宇宙论坛里，众多BOSS、主角们，发现前阵子还被人按在地上biu的“新人”，最近开始活跃起来了！
不由得一个个在帖子下面回忆往昔……许多天生主角命的会员都有类似的经历！
当然，还有人恶意的提醒着ID为“真·主角”的新人，让他别忘了把biu过他的人灭口……之后还要配上奸笑的表情！
好奇如果他们知道，“真·主角”还有一个管理员大号的话，还能不能笑得出来？
此时作为最后一名的关立远，并没有引起太多人的注意，宋院长显然已经不怎么关注这边的情况，几名联盟的议员已经准备好收回水晶，最开始安排关立远插班的辛主任仿佛不认识他、也不关注，已经准备要组织毕业生们退场了……
唯一还关注关立远的，大概就只有贡文、钟离秋、魏樱樱三人了！
当然，前者是等待着，自己可以肆意报复关立远的一刻正式到来，而后两者则是在担心、不忍，钟离秋已经在跃跃欲试、似乎准备要大闹一番……觉醒为“圣虎斗士”令她有一种自己优势很大的错觉。
看到钟离秋的眼神之后，贡连家主终于想起来，之前钟离家族找他有什么事情了！
甚至已经在考虑要不要趁机示好一下……
为了个一只手指就能碾死的小人物，而彻底得罪死一位超级天才，似乎有些亏了！
至于贡文？本来就不是他最在意的儿子！在他看来，不过是小孩子胡闹的范畴。
之前贡氏家族和钟离家族的关系本来就不好，一个小人物给他儿子玩玩儿出口气也没什么大不了，但是现在……入门阶时就直接觉醒“圣虎斗士”职业者！贡连家主心中也摇摆了起来。
就在关立远的右手放在了水晶球上，宋院长都已经准备好了，对着没反应的水晶球说一句“开灵仪式到此结束”的时候，一阵刺眼的白光亮起！
甚至连忍不住闭上眼睛的魏樱樱，都感觉到了白光，而诧异的睁开了眼睛，而钟离秋和贡文更是已经傻掉了……
当然，傻掉的人还有许多……准确的说是，在这一刻所有人的脑回路都暂时的堵住了！
关立远趾高气昂的摆了一会儿造型，结果一直没人反应过来，搞得他也不好强行装“哔”，只得尴尬的说道：“那个……好了吗？”
“怎么可能！”
“两、两、两个？”
“双职业者！居然在入门时、就觉醒了两个职业？”
“他不是倒数第一吗？虽然有时‘开灵’没什么规律，但是这也太没有规律了吧……”

“那两个是什么职业？好像都很生僻，议员们已经在翻图鉴了！”
而就在这议论纷纷中，一声如丧考妣的声音，显得格外刺耳……
“这不可能！一定是出了问题！那个小杂种是我们家买来的奴隶！他一定是我的奴隶！”
所有人都诧异的看了过去……
大家之前惊讶归惊讶，但是谁都明白，开灵时就觉醒双职业意味着什么，就算是冤枉到家的第四名，都没有将抱怨的话说出口。
但是现在……
看到贡文之后，不少人都反应了过来，即便不是一个班的，也隐约听说过“傻大胆”、“一时爽”的典故！
只是大多数人，这时才在心里感叹道：原来他就是那个“一时爽”啊！
贡文忽然一哆嗦，发现主席台上许多人都冷眼看着自己，巴议员更是冷冷的说道：“开灵法阵和开灵水晶是联盟提供的，你认为有问题就去联盟申辩……呵呵，也没什么可申辩的，成功了就是成功了，还能因为你申辩就、老天就收回职业符文吗？”
而所有目光中，最令贡文畏惧的，正是贡连家主、也就是他父亲不满的眼神……
显然贡文和贡连的父子关系，远不像钟离秋和钟离犼父女俩那么亲近！
“找到了！是‘规则系’的‘异界召唤师’……我就说这和‘召唤师’系列的符文有些像！还有一个是‘元素系’的‘骨元素使’！”另一名议员忽然比对着图鉴说道。
【骨元素使？异界召唤师？听起来还不错的样子……“异界召唤师”不会是召唤异世界生物的吧？】关立远眼前一亮，心中和企鹅交流着。
【绝对不可能！宇宙意志怎么可能会自己联通其他宇宙呢？所谓的“异界召唤师”的“异界”，肯定是同一个宇宙中的其他位面的意思……和论坛规则中的“每个世界仅有单一会员”的“世界”不是一个含义。】企鹅笃定的说道。
本小章还未完~.~，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
In the Big Universe Forum, many bosses and protagonists discovered that the "newcomers" who were pinned to the ground a while ago have become active recently!
I can’t help but reminisce about the past one by one under the post... Many members who are born in the main life have similar experiences!
Of course, there are also people who maliciously remind the newcomer with the ID of "True Protagonist", asking him not to forget to silence the people who have cheated on him... and then add a sly smile on his face!
I wonder if they would still be able to laugh if they knew that the "real protagonist" also had an administrator account?
At this time, Guan Liyuan, who was the last one, did not attract much attention. Dean Song obviously no longer paid much attention to the situation here. Several members of the alliance were ready to take back the crystal. Director Xin, who originally arranged for Guan Liyuan to join the class, seemed not to recognize him and did not pay attention to him. He was already preparing to organize the graduates to leave...
The only ones who still pay attention to Guan Liyuan are probably Gongwen, Zhong Liqiu, and Wei Yingying!
Of course, the former is waiting for the moment when he can take revenge on Guan Liyuan officially, while the latter two are worried and unable to bear it. Zhong Liqiu is already eager to try and seems to be preparing to make a big fuss... Awakening as a "Holy Tiger Fighter" gives her the illusion that she has great advantages.
After seeing the look in Zhongli Qiu's eyes, the head of the Gonglian family finally remembered that the Zhongli family had something to do with him before!
I'm even considering whether to take the opportunity to show my kindness...
It seems a bit of a loss to completely offend a super genius for a little guy who can be crushed to death with one finger!
As for the tribute? He was never the son he cared about most! In his opinion, it was just a child's nonsense.
In the past, the relationship between the Gong family and the Zhongli family was not good, and it was no big deal for a little person to vent his anger on his son, but now... the "Holy Tiger Fighter" professional is awakened directly at the entry level! The head of the Gonglian family also swayed in his heart.
Just when Guan Liyuan placed his right hand on the crystal ball and Dean Song was already ready to say, "This is the end of the spiritual opening ceremony" to the unresponsive crystal ball, a burst of dazzling white light lit up!
Even Wei Yingying, who couldn't help but close her eyes, felt the white light and opened her eyes in surprise, while Zhong Liqiu and Gong Wen were already dumbfounded...
Of course, there are still many people who are stupid... To be precise, everyone's brain circuits are temporarily blocked at this moment!
Guan Liyuan posed arrogantly for a while, but no one responded, so he couldn't forcefully pretend to beep, so he had to say awkwardly: "Um... are you ready?"
"How is that possible!"
"Two, two, two?"
"A dual-professional person! You actually awakened two professions when you first started?"
"Isn't he the last one? Although sometimes there is no regularity in 'opening up', but this is too irregular..."
"What are the professions of those two? They seem to be very unfamiliar, and the congressmen are already looking through the illustrations!"
And in the midst of this discussion, a voice that sounded like mourning for a concubine seemed particularly harsh...
"This is impossible! There must be something wrong! That little bastard is a slave bought by our family! He must be my slave!"
Everyone looked over in surprise...
Everyone was surprised before, but everyone understood what it meant to awaken dual professions when the soul was opened. Even the fourth place, who was wrongfully accused, did not complain.
But now...
After seeing the tribute, many people reacted. Even if they were not in the same class, they had vaguely heard of the allusions of "silly and bold" and "momentary pleasure"!
But most people sighed in their hearts at this time: It turns out that he is the "momentary pleasure"!
Gongwen suddenly trembled and found that many people on the rostrum were looking at him coldly. Councilor Ba even said coldly: "Kai LingThe magic circle and the spirit-opening crystal are provided by the alliance. If you think there is a problem, go to the alliance to plead... Haha, there is nothing to defend. If it succeeds, it is a success. Can God take back the professional runes just because you defended it? "
And among all the looks, the one that scares Gongwen the most is the dissatisfied look in the head of the Gonglian family, his father...
Obviously the father-son relationship between Gongwen and Gonglian is far less close than the father-daughter relationship between Zhongliqiu and Zhonglihuang!
"Found it! It's the 'Alien Summoner' of the 'Rule System'... I'd say it's somewhat similar to the runes of the 'Summoner' series! There is also a ‘Bone Elementalist’ from the ‘Elemental System’! "Another congressman suddenly said while comparing the illustrations.
[Bone Elementalist? Summoner from another world? It sounds pretty good... "Alien Summoner" doesn't summon creatures from other worlds, right? ] Guan Liyuan's eyes lit up, and he was communicating with Penguin in his heart.
【Absolutely impossible! How can the will of the universe connect to other universes on its own? The "other world" of the so-called "alien summoner" must mean other planes in the same universe... It does not have the same meaning as the "world" of "each world has only a single member" in the forum rules. ] Penguin said firmly.
